confirm_34011.official_checkpoints: Official TFT checkpoints were trained on official train (including SYNA-003/004). Confirm 34011 models were fit fresh and did not load those weights. Confirm pooled/fine-tune train sets still contained SYNA-007/010/011.
confirm_34011.previous_finetune_default: PR #22 selected tft_finetune on official validation interval score. That default failed confirmation: target-only was better and more stable on 34011 test studies. Fine-tune and CQR stay experimental.
confirm_34011.supported_claim: SYNA-003 and SYNA-004 had not been reported as test studies before. They were official training studies. Confirmation *test* therefore used new test labels, but confirmation training and validation were not holdout-free.
confirm_34011.unsupported_claim: Confirmation 34011 was an untouched study holdout. Previously reported test studies were excluded from the confirmation experiment.

cqr_metric_policy.calibration_data: separate calibration split; not validation, not test
cqr_metric_policy.mean_quantile_loss_on_calibrated: Average pinball over 0.1/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.9 after the shift. That is not the training QuantileLoss and is not comparable to raw pinball as a proper score for the original quantile head.
cqr_metric_policy.q0_1_q0_9: shifted by ±margin; interval score, coverage, and width use these
cqr_metric_policy.q0_5: unchanged; MAE and median pinball match the raw table
cqr_metric_policy.report: raw_* from original quantiles; cqr_* from calibrated endpoints

epoch_counting.note: epochs_completed counts callback rows that logged train_loss. Legacy epochs_run was lightning current_epoch + 1.

official_series_counts.note: n_animals_in_split counts unique USUBJID on the split. n_tft_series counts animals with at least min_encoder_length+1 observed visits, the TimeSeriesDataSet filter. Official train is 214 animals / 211 series because three animals have a single DAY=7 visit.

pinball_note: Raw pinball is the mean QuantileLoss on the original head. CQR pinball uses the shifted 10% and 90% endpoints and is not the training objective. Report both; do not treat CQR pinball as an improvement of the TFT quantile fit.
